cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your lift has earned approval. You may have Saturday off; I'll cover your shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole weekend for you is authorized, then. I won't have you doing more for me than I do for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I still drive you Sunday? I've swapped my shift to take you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your holiday is approved instead. I'll cancel my flight and cover it. You may take the longer break; I intend to make this even in my favour.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 authorizes a larger break to surpass prior cover; A5 approves holiday relief and sacrifices travel after B reveals another rearranged favor.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 yesterday cover causes A3 weekend offer; B4 explicit airport drive and swapped shift cause A5 cancellation and holiday cover.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 disclose practical sacrifices while trying to help, giving A real effort to exceed.

heightening.evidence: B4 favor tied to A flight causes A5 to abandon that flight and offer a longer period of work instead.

specificity.evidence: A1 lift and shifts, B2 rest cover and B4 airport arrangement establish concrete time sacrifices.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 even-in-my-favour is earned by the competitive scale already stated in A3, though the ending is explicit about motive.
